role: Non-author of the observer, prospective fixture bank and qualification proposal. Read-only source and fixture-design review.
scope: Two isolated Python tools plus prospective documentation, using unchanged safe_child. No official executor or protocol wiring. This review is not an execution event, fixture pass, runtime admission or gameplay permit.
source_findings: Reads actual CLI direct parent only; Python private fake-proc/parent/clock seams are test interfaces, not an admission/security authority.

Checks process lifetime via PID/start ticks/boot ID; hashes the kernel executable inode, expected raw command and explicit argument file; validates exact ordered entry identities and per-file bytes. Reads twice and compares both snapshots, with parent/lifetime rechecks.

Canonical disjoint repository/Gradle roots, path validation and symlink/nonregular rejection are explicit. Positive finite byte/entry/journal/time limits and per-file before/after metadata checks constrain observations.

Exclusive attempt/output files preserve intent, available partial journal and final typed error; an existing attempt is not overwritten. Fsync is local-file observation durability, not host/remote survival proof.

Module/proposal correctly limit successful output to two launch-byte snapshots. They explicitly exclude already-loaded-class identity, JDK/native/agent/classloader closure, in-flight immutability, authoritative expected-input acceptance and official execution.

fixture_review.negative_case_strength: Tests exercise changed content and order, missing/duplicate/outside entries, symlink escape, wrong executable/command, direct-parent change and same-PID lifetime change, malformed argument encoding, between-snapshot mutation, missing/byte/time/journal bounds, missing/FIFO input, and exclusive-output preservation; they assert failed result scope and retained evidence.
fixture_review.actual_probe: One embedded Java class independently constructs and launches a direct Python observer child from a known single-class classpath. Expected bytes/digests come from explicit generated files and argv, not the observer inventory implementation. It checks actual matched result and zero claims/initializations. JDK21 and observed versions must be bound by the later gate.
fixture_review.preservation: Retained fixture-root mode preserves inputs, fake procfs, observations, actual source/class/arguments/logs/exits. FIFO case records its owned empty FIFO type before removing that pipe; no omitted bytes are claimed.
fixture_review.limits: Static design review only; neither21 unit cases nor actual-parent probe was executed, and neither is an engine/performance/capacity experiment.

corrected_prefreeze_findings.P02: Probe commands launch owned sessions, use waitid(WNOWAIT) to keep child PID unreaped until killpg, then wait; Java child-forced-termination path also waits. No signal targets an unrelated process.
corrected_prefreeze_findings.history_limit: Initial draft read preceded preserved-copy capture; record explicitly says P01 was already fixed in that preserved observer copy. No false attribution to a frozen hash.
